title: A rotation-invariant analytic germ descends through a power
statement: Let w be a positive natural number and P:ℂ→ℂ be analytic at zero. Put ζ=exp(2πi/w). Suppose there exists a real s>0 such that P(ζt)=P(t) whenever ‖t‖<s. Then there exist C:ℂ→ℂ analytic at zero and a real r>0 such that P(t)=C(t^w) whenever ‖t‖<r.
lean_statement: ∀ (w : ℕ) (P : ℂ → ℂ), 0 < w → AnalyticAt ℂ P 0 → (∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < s → P (Complex.exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I / (w : ℂ)) * t) = P t) → ∃ C : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ C 0 ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < r → P t = C (t ^ w)
